title.zh: New Treasury rules could change how stablecoin issuers get your dollars back
title.en: New Treasury rules could change how stablecoin issuers get your dollars back

current_state.zh: The SEC's push to route more Treasury trades through central clearing could reshape Treasury-market liquidity and collateral costs, directly affecting how stablecoin issuers convert reserve assets into dollars for redemptions.
